subject: Azure Marketplace MAP kickoff: partner onboarding & evaluation timeline
content:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Erin McDowell <erin.mcdowell@microsoft.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@cloudbridge.com>, Daniel Ruiz <daniel.ruiz@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace MAP kickoff: partner onboarding & evaluation timeline

Hi Erin, Priya, Daniel —

Thanks for taking time today. As discussed, this thread will capture the mutual action plan (MAP) to get Redwood on the Azure Marketplace with CloudBridge as our channel partner, and to align evaluation milestones with the prospective PoC customers we referenced (StratusApps + HelixHealth).

High-level objectives for this MAP:
- Publish a validated offer in Azure Marketplace (commercial + trial flow)
- Complete joint technical validation with 2 pilot customers (security & performance checks)
- Enable lead routing and ingestion into CloudBridge's co-sell pipeline
- Agree commercial terms and finalize SOW for initial deployment

Proposed owners (please confirm or reassign):
- Marketplace listing tasks (manifest, offer packaging): Erin McDowell (Microsoft Marketplace Ops) + Daniel Ruiz (CloudBridge)
- Technical validation & integration tests (KV cache, networking): Sergio Alvarez (Redwood runtime) + Daniel Ruiz
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC2, data flows): Dev Patel (Redwood security) + Priya Shah
- Commercial & SOW: Marissa Cole (Redwood Partnerships) + Priya Shah
- Customer evaluation coordination (pilot logistics, access): Monica Patel (Redwood CS) + CloudBridge PMs

Target timeline (high level):
- Week 1 (Jun 8–12): MAP agreement, roles confirmed, initial asset drop (listing artifacts + SOC2 evidence).
- Week 2 (Jun 15–19): Azure offer package build + internal validation environment for pilots.
- Week 3 (Jun 22–26): Pilot 1 kickoff (StratusApps) — 2-week validation window.
- Week 5 (Jul 6–10): Pilot 2 kickoff (HelixHealth) — 2-week validation window.
- Week 7 (Jul 20–24): Listing go-live + lead routing enabled; finalize SOW and commercial terms.

Immediate asks (can each owner reply with ETA by EOD Wednesday?):
1) Erin/Daniel: confirm Azure offer owner and whether we need any additional publisher details beyond the checklist I attached.
2) Dev: confirm which security artifacts you can share this week (SOC2 cover letter, data flow diagram).
3) Marissa/Priya: confirm commercial cadence — who will handle initial SOW redlines and signoff?
4) Sergio/Monica: confirm instrumentation plan for pilot (tracing, token/latency metrics) and how we’ll share results.

Attachments: Redwood-CloudBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template), Azure_Marketplace_Checklist.pdf (Microsoft checklist), SOW_draft_Redwood_CloudBridge.docx, partner_onboarding_playbook.pptx

I’ll maintain the MAP spreadsheet in the SharePoint link below and update as items move.

SharePoint MAP: https://sharepoint.redwood.com/sites/partners/CloudBridge/MAP
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth kickoff.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Soojin — happy to kick this off. A couple quick notes from the marketplace ops perspective:
- We received the checklist; the next steps are the offer manifest + publisher verification (ID match). I’ll send a brief form for the publisher metadata this afternoon.
- For trial flows we recommend a sandbox subscription path (we can help with a temporary offer configuration for pilot customers).
- Lead ingestion: we need a webhook endpoint for CloudBridge to accept leads (or we can route through the co-sell connector).

I’ll confirm the exact dates for internal validation by tomorrow.

Erin

- CloudBridge will operate the co-sell intake and routing; Daniel will be our primary listing liaison.

Thanks team — Sergio here. Quick technical responses and next steps: 
- I’ll draft a one-page network diagram and the minimal infra footprint we need for the sandbox tenant (VNETs, outbound egress rules, port ranges). ETA EOD Thursday (June 11).
- For the pilot instrumentation, Redwood will provide a tracing dashboard URL (read-only) and a token-level latency/cost CSV export weekly. Monica, please tell me the email for dashboard access.
- Data residency: during pilot we'll keep logs in an encrypted Azure storage account scoped to the sandbox subscription; retention will be 30 days unless the customer requests otherwise. Dev, please attach SOC2 summary to the thread when you can.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
